verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing page lists "scheduled searches that surface new events on the web," and Websets can send real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched, so there is a recurring-search capability with push notifications. The scheduling is limited to searches, though, rather than arbitrary jobs or workflows, and it rests on a single pricing-page line. Missing for 10: documentation of how schedules are configured (cadence, API or dashboard controls), scheduling of general workflows beyond searches, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
